title: Chat timeline
summary: Shows the messages of one chat, loads older ones on scroll, and sends text.

runs.description: Native text and formatting in reading order.

id.description: The SDK's unique timeline item id. Stable key for the row.

kind.description: text: a text message. undecryptable: the phone has no key for it yet. unsupported: any other event type in the slice.

body.description: Plain text of a text message.

richText.description: Native text runs parsed from the supported Matrix HTML body; unknown formats use body. Separate from the original text for copying and editing.

isEmote.description: true for m.emote. Prefix the displayed body with * and the sender name; keep body unchanged for copying and editing. Defaults to false.

isOwn.description: true when this account sent it.

sentAt.description: Origin server time of the event.

sendState.description: Only own messages use sending and failed.

notice.description: Set on a text message from another account whose badge (GET /v1/badges/{userId}) verifies with lvl institution (docs/badge-attestation.md). The row shows as a notice card, not a chat bubble.

name.description: The verified name from the institution badge (payload name).

domains.description: The badge's domains. Empty: no link in the notice is clickable.

roomName.description: The chat name for the title.

isOfficial.description: DM only: the other person's full user ID is in registries/official-accounts.json. The header shows the Bipe badge after the name (bipe_badge_official, label bipe_badge_official_a11y), as in chat-list.

messages.description: Oldest first, as the timeline listener gives the items.

reachedStart.description: true when the start of the chat is loaded.

peerAway.description: DM only (RoomInfo.isDm, ADR 0141). left: Room.member of the other person has membership leave (or ban). accountGone: also Client.getProfile for the person fails with ErrorKind notFound (a deactivated account has no profile). none: joined or invited, or a group.

profileNotice.description: 1:1 chats only: bipe_profile_notice_name_photo with the person's display name, when profileFactLines gives notice for the other person (name and photo changed at most noticePairHours apart, the later change younger than noticeDays). Amber (warning colour tokens), above the composer.

theftMark.description: 1:1 chats: the stolen_at of a valid theft statement (docs/theft-mark.md) for the other person. Shows bipe_theft_banner_title and bipe_theft_banner_body (red, danger colour tokens) above the composer in a 1:1 chat, and bipe_theft_message_marker under each message from that account sent from stolen_at minus markedMessageMinutes on.

loadHistory.effect: Back-paginates 20 events at a time when the view scrolls near the top, until the timeline has 10 more messages (events that give no row do not count), at most 5 pages. A failed page is tried 3 times, 1 s and 2 s apart, then the load stops. While the top stays on screen, the view runs loadHistory again after each load that did not fail and after each change of the messages. Does nothing when reachedStart is true or a load runs.

send.effect: Sends draft as a plain-text message through the timeline, then clears draft. The message shows at once with sendState sending.

retrySend.effect: Sends a failed own message again.

inviteAgain.effect: peerAway left only. When RoomPowerLevels.canOwnUserInvite: Room.inviteUserById for the other person; peerAway turns none once the person is invited, so the bar goes away. Else (a DM created with the DM power levels, where nobody can invite): a new DM with the person, as person-profile message does, and chat-timeline opens it. The new room is the newest, so dm-selection shows it and hides this one; nothing is deleted. A failure shows bipe_dm_invite_again_failed.

notes: Assistant sends (ADR 0210, bipe-chat/bipe#439): a message whose content has chat.bipe.assistant with a client name (assistantSender, test-vectors/assistant-send.json) shows bipe_app_assistant_sent_label with the sender's display name, in small text under the bubble, on every member's app. The sender's own app shows it too.

CVM stop order (ADR 0077, bipe-chat/bipe#238): in a DM whose other person has a verified company seal with a cvm stop order (test-vectors/cvm-lines.json danger true), a red caution card with bipe_cvm_stop_order_card and the date sits at the top of the timeline. It stays while the badge says so. It comes from the signed badge only.

Official accounts (ADR 0117, bipe-chat/bipe#384): isOfficial follows the chat-list rule (exact user ID in BipeRegistries.officialAccountIDs, a DM only). A group never shows the badge, even with an official account in it.
Send is off while draft is blank after trimming.
undecryptable shows the message-undecryptable row in place of the body (cause and help action there).

timeline-rows replaces messages with rows. Replies, reactions, edits, deletions, read receipts, typing, the actions sheet, handle-change lines and scam warnings have their own specs (bipe-chat/bipe#559). Media is a later issue.

The other person left a DM (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#533): a lasting bar above the composer shows bipe_dm_left with the person's name and one button, bipe_action_invite_again. accountGone shows bipe_dm_account_gone with no button. There is no popup on composer focus. The composer stays on: a message waits in the room for a person who comes back.

A blocked person's DM (ADR 0141, bipe-chat/bipe#536, block-person): bipe_app_blocked_bar with the person's name and bipe_action_unblock_person replaces the composer. The chat stays in the list. The bar wins over the peerAway bar.

Official notice (bipe-chat/bipe#245, ADR 0036, institutions.md 4.4): a message whose notice is set shows as a card, not a bubble: the institution's square avatar and name, bipe_notice_label, bipe_notice_level, the body, then bipe_notice_safety as a fixed line the sender cannot change. Accessibility: one element read as bipe_notice_a11y with the name, then the body. A link in the body is clickable only when test-vectors/notice-links.json says so for the badge's domains (reference tools/lib/notice.mjs); every other link is plain text, with no link preview. The notice comes from the signed badge only: the app never makes a notice from a display name, a room name or room state, and a badge that fails any check (expired, master key mismatch) gives an ordinary bubble. Who may write first (institutions.md decision 10.1) is a server rule, so the app does not refuse a notice in a chat the institution opened. No issuer signs institution badges yet, so no account shows the card today. Default chosen: the safety line is a draft until MZ settles the wording of institutions.md 10.3.

Brand marks (ADR 0162, spec brand-mark): in a DM with a reseller, the header shows the first verified mark's line under the title (bipe_brand_mark_more for the others), as text inside the title button that opens person-profile; the sheet opens from the line there. bipe_brand_mark_ended shows once there after a mark the phone saw is gone.

Profile change notice (ADR 0049, bipe-chat/bipe#598): in a joined 1:1 chat the app reads POST /v1/profile-facts for the other person when the chat opens, at most once an hour. The notice is a fact, not a block: it never hides a message, and a failed call shows nothing. Not in groups and not for requests (chat-request shows the facts lines).

Theft mark (ADR 0044, bipe-chat/bipe#600): the app asks POST /v1/theft-marks for the other person of a 1:1 chat when the chat opens and at most every checkMinutes (registries/theft-protection.json). It verifies each statement with the badge keys (test-vectors/theft-marks.json). A failed call or an invalid statement shows nothing. Group chats do not check marks in this version.

Upgraded groups (bipe-chat/bipe#773, Matrix room upgrades: m.room.tombstone and the m.room.create predecessor): when RoomInfo.successorRoom is set, a bar bipe_room_upgrade_replaced with the button bipe_room_upgrade_go takes the place of the composer; the button joins the successor (Client.joinRoomByIdOrAlias, via the server of the old room ID when it has one) and opens it. A failure shows bipe_error_generic. When RoomInfo.predecessorRoom is set, a line bipe_room_upgrade_continues (%1$s the old group's name, else bipe_group_common_no_room_name) above the timeline opens the old group. The chat list shows only the newest version of a group the person is in (DeduplicateVersions in chat-list). Default chosen: the copy says the group was replaced, never archived, so it does not read like the chat archive (Arquivo, bipe-chat/bipe#662). mz can overrule.
